signature: SUBROUTINE DLARRB( N, D, LLD, IFIRST, ILAST, RTOL1,

params.name: d
params.reference: The N diagonal elements of the diagonal matrix D.

params.name: ifirst
params.reference: The index of the first eigenvalue to be computed.

params.name: ilast
params.reference: The index of the last eigenvalue to be computed.

params.name: rtol2
params.reference: Tolerance for the convergence of the bisection intervals. An interval \[LEFT,RIGHT\] has converged if $\mathrm{RIGHT}-\mathrm{LEFT} < \max ( \mathrm{RTOL1} \, \mathrm{GAP}, \mathrm{RTOL2} \, \max (|\mathrm{LEFT}|,|\mathrm{RIGHT}|) )$ where GAP is the (estimated) distance to the nearest eigenvalue.

params.name: offset
params.reference: Offset for the arrays W, `WGAP` and `WERR`, i.e., the `IFIRST`-`OFFSET` through `ILAST`-`OFFSET` elements of these arrays are to be used.

params.name: w
params.reference: On input, W( `IFIRST`-`OFFSET` ) through W( `ILAST`-`OFFSET` ) are estimates of the eigenvalues of L D L^T indexed `IFIRST` through `ILAST`. On output, these estimates are refined.

params.name: WGAP
params.reference: On input, the (estimated) gaps between consecutive eigenvalues of L D L^T, i.e., `WGAP(I-OFFSET)` is the gap between eigenvalues I and I+1. Note that if `IFIRST = ILAST` then `WGAP(IFIRST-OFFSET)` must be set to ZERO. On output, these gaps are refined.

params.name: WERR
params.reference: On input, WERR( `IFIRST`-`OFFSET` ) through WERR( `ILAST`-`OFFSET` ) are the errors in the estimates of the corresponding elements in W. On output, these errors are refined.

params.name: pivmin
params.reference: The minimum pivot in the Sturm sequence.

params.name: spdiam
params.reference: The spectral diameter of the matrix.

params.name: twist
params.reference: The twist index for the twisted factorization that is used for the negcount. `TWIST = N`: Compute negcount from L D L^T - LAMBDA $I = L+ D+ L$+^T `TWIST = 1`: Compute negcount from L D L^T - LAMBDA $I = U- D- U$-^T `TWIST = R`: Compute negcount from L D L^T - LAMBDA $I = N(r)$ `D(r)` `N(r)`

overrides.reason: WGAP is documented as dimension (N-1), but dlarrb.f reads RGAP = WGAP( II ) for II up to ILAST-OFFSET (lines 263, 270), which is WGAP(N) when ILAST = N and OFFSET = 0, a valid call. The caller dlarrv documents WGAP as dimension (N) (dlarrv.f:177). The JS wrapper must size WGAP by what the code touches, N (ticket 0068).
